title: Cosmic Oracle with Crystal Ball
description: A surreal portrait of a woman with three overlapping faces: a blonde woman with flowing hair at the top, a dark-skinned woman with gold accents in the center, and a translucent white face on the right. She holds a glowing purple crystal ball containing a red planetary landscape with a small astronaut and a skull-like figure. The background features a starry black space with swirling galaxies, floating astronauts on asteroids, geometric shapes, and purple floral patterns on her flowing robes.
